questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.1.

questions.question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

The interviewer asked Ashok, "Why did you leave that job last month?"

options.text: The interviewer asked Ashok why you have left that job the previous month.
The interviewer asked Ashok that why did he leave that job the previous month.
The interviewer asked Ashok that why he leave that job the last month.
The interviewer asked Ashok why he had left that job the previous month.

questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 4.**
 
• Given active sentence is in interrogative form therefore interrogative will be changed to an assertive sentence. To change the sentence into an indirect sentence. Simple past will be changed to past perfect tense, 'last month' will be changed to 'previous month'. 
 
• **Therefore, all these conditions are satisfied only in option 4.**

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

With this heatwave on, we have a terrible weather.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **a terrible weather**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the usage of the **indefinite article 'a__**' with an **__uncountable__ noun** __**'weather**__**'.**
 
• The word** **__**"weather"**__** **does **not** take the indefinite article **"a"** before it,
 
• **Remove** article** 'a'** to make the sentence grammatically correct.

 

**Correct sentence:*** With this heatwave on, we have terrible weather.*

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

They will complete the painting in a week's time.

options.text: The painting will be completed in a week's time.
The painting is completed in a week's time.
The painting was completed in a week's time.
The painting had been completed in a week's time.

questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 1. **
 
• In active voice, the subject performs the action denoted by the verb.
 
• On the other hand, a sentence is in the passive voice when the subject of the sentence is acted upon by the verb.
 
• When changing from active voice to passive, we do not change the tense of the given sentence.
 
• **Except Option 1 all other options are in different tense. Therefore option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. The woman is wearing an evening dress and heavy make up, which is now smeared across her cheeks.

B. But, who is she, and how did she get there?

C. It's seven in the morning and the Bantrys wake to find the body of a young woman in their library.

D. The respectable Bantrys invite Miss Marple to solve the mystery before tongues start to wag.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is Option 2.**

 
• Sentence 'c' is the independent sentence, hence, it will be the first sentence.
 
• Hence, option 1 and 3 are eliminated.
 
• Sentence 'c' will be followed the sentence 'a' because sentence 'c' talks about a woman and sentence 'a' talks about the same woman.
 
• This combination is given in only option 2, hence, it will be the correct answer.
